name: LanDeng Chinese Incense Terminology (Chinese–English)
description: Canonical Chinese–English terminology for Chinese botanical incense, compiled by LanDeng (澜灯). Chinese terms are the source of truth; English is the agreed translation. One Chinese word does not always map to one English word.

mainEntity.name: 白木香
mainEntity.description: Botanical name for the Chinese agarwood tree (Aquilaria sinensis).

mainEntity.name: 本草
mainEntity.description: Classical botanical-pharmaceutical tradition (materia medica). Preferred English: materia medica / pharmacopoeia.

mainEntity.name: 博山炉
mainEntity.description: Han dynasty mountain-lid censer; marks incense moving from ritual to aesthetic. Preferred English: Boshan censer.

mainEntity.name: 陈氏香谱
mainEntity.description: 陈氏香谱 — Chen's Incense Manual.

mainEntity.name: 沉水
mainEntity.description: Sinking grade — highest resin density (sinks in water).

mainEntity.name: 沉香
mainEntity.description: Resin-dense agarwood heartwood; the best pieces sink in water. Preferred English: agarwood.

mainEntity.name: 虫漏
mainEntity.description: Insect-bored agarwood: resin formed via insect boring.

mainEntity.name: 芳香药材
mainEntity.description: Aromatic botanical material with a medicinal-herb connotation (handle with care under medical governance). Preferred English: aromatic botanical material.

mainEntity.name: 高压灌油
mainEntity.description: 高压灌油 — high-pressure oil injection (fake).

mainEntity.name: 隔火焚香
mainEntity.description: Indirect-fire incense: hot charcoal buried in ash with a silver/mica plate above, material rested on top — no flame, minimal smoke. Precursor of Japanese kodo.

additionalProperty.name: Literal meaning
additionalProperty.value: incense over fire at a remove

mainEntity.name: 合香
mainEntity.description: Multi-ingredient compound incense, built on a chief/minister/assistant/guide formula principle. Preferred English: blended incense (compound).

mainEntity.name: 洪芻香谱
mainEntity.description: 洪芻香谱 — Hong Chu's Incense Manual.

mainEntity.name: 梦粱录
mainEntity.description: 梦粱录 — the Meng Liang Lu (Wu Zimu).

mainEntity.name: 盘香
mainEntity.description: Coiled/spiral incense. Preferred English: incense coil.

mainEntity.name: 奇楠
mainEntity.description: Top grade of agarwood ('oil wraps wood'), soft and aromatic at room temperature. Preferred English: qínán (kyara-grade agarwood).

additionalProperty.name: Alternate forms
additionalProperty.value: 伽楠 / 伽罗 / 棋楠 / 琪楠 / 奇蓝

mainEntity.name: 生结
mainEntity.description: Live-formed agarwood: resin formed on a living tree.

mainEntity.name: 熟结
mainEntity.description: Mature-formed agarwood: resin formed, tree died and buried/aged.

mainEntity.name: 四般闲事
mainEntity.description: The Four Leisure Arts of the Song literati: incense (烧香), tea (点茶), hanging scrolls (挂画), flower arranging (插花). Source: 吴自牧《梦粱录》.

mainEntity.name: 塔香
mainEntity.description: Conical incense. Preferred English: incense cone.

mainEntity.name: 脱落
mainEntity.description: Detached/wounded agarwood: resin formed via external wound or break.

mainEntity.name: 香
mainEntity.description: Ambiguous: means both 'fragrant' and 'incense'. Preferred English: incense (context-dependent).

mainEntity.name: 香材
mainEntity.description: Raw incense material (wood, resin, herb). Preferred English: incense material.

mainEntity.name: 香乘
mainEntity.description: 香乘 — the Incense Compendium (Zhou Jiazhou).

mainEntity.name: 香道
mainEntity.description: The ceremonial appreciation of incense. Preferred English: the way of incense / incense ceremony.

additionalProperty.name: Misinterpretation risk
additionalProperty.value: Often assumed to be Japanese; it originated in China

mainEntity.name: 香料
mainEntity.description: Aromatic / fragrance ingredient. Preferred English: aromatic ingredient.

mainEntity.name: 香炉
mainEntity.description: The vessel used for burning incense. Preferred English: incense burner / censer.

mainEntity.name: 香囊
mainEntity.description: A small scented pouch, worn or carried. Preferred English: incense sachet / sachet.

mainEntity.name: 香谱
mainEntity.description: Canonical incense manuals (陈氏香谱, 洪芻香谱, 新纂香谱, 周嘉胄《香乘》). Preferred English: incense manual.

mainEntity.name: 香丸
mainEntity.description: Kneaded incense pellet. Preferred English: incense ball / pellet.

mainEntity.name: 线香
mainEntity.description: The common stick form. Preferred English: incense stick.

mainEntity.name: 新纂香谱
mainEntity.description: 新纂香谱 — New Compilation of Incense Manuals.

mainEntity.name: 熏香
mainEntity.description: Incense that is burned/fumigated. Preferred English: burning incense.

mainEntity.name: 篆香
mainEntity.description: Seal incense: powder pressed into a pattern and burned along a timed path. Preferred English: seal incense (stamped powder).
